questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Naturism and why some people enjoy being naked outdoors
How to stay warm while walking in winter
The laws about clothing in different countries
Why people swim in cold seas for charity
questions.why: They discuss naturists and why being naked in nature might be good for us.

questions.q: How does Neil feel about being naked in public?
options: He does it every summer
He'd like to try it one day
It's not his idea of fun
He thinks it should be illegal
questions.why: Neil says stripping off publicly 'is not my idea of fun'.

questions.q: What does Donna Price say it feels like to be naked in nature?
options: Cold and uncomfortable, especially in the wind
A lovely feeling of freedom and connection with nature
Embarrassing at first, and then rather boring
Exciting, because it feels a little bit dangerous
questions.why: She talks about being at one with nature and a great feeling of liberation and freedom.

questions.q: What does Donna Price advise people who are new to naturism?
options: Go for a long naked walk in the countryside straight away
Join a large naturist group before trying it alone
Only try it on holiday, far away from where you live
Start at home or in the garden until it feels normal
questions.why: She says she'd never advise a naked walk first; do it at home or in your garden to get comfortable.

questions.q: What does Georgina ask after hearing Donna talk about being at one with nature?
options: Whether it's actually legal to walk around naked
Whether it's too cold to do it in the British winter
Whether you could feel that with your clothes on
Whether Neil would like to try naked rambling himself
questions.why: Georgina asks, 'couldn't you do that with your clothes on?'

questions.q: What does Neil say about the law in the UK?
options: It's generally not against the law to be naked in public
Being naked outdoors is only allowed on special beaches
Naturists must get a special licence from the council
It is illegal everywhere outdoors, even in your garden
questions.why: Neil says in the UK it's generally not against the law to be naked in public.

questions.q: According to Donna Price, how do most members of the public react when they meet naked walkers?
options: They call the police
They are shocked and angry
They ignore them completely
They are mostly encouraging
questions.why: She says the majority of responses are actually very encouraging.

questions.q: Why won't Georgina be trying naked rambling soon?
options: Her friends and family would laugh at her
It's too cold and she doesn't want insect bites
She lives in a big city, far from the countryside
She thinks it is wrong to be naked in public
questions.why: She says it's too cold and she doesn't want to be bitten by bugs in the countryside.
